intention: The operator's review lane holds only what his head has to settle: a berth whose ticket measurement has already closed leaves the lane by derivation, and troubles leave his lane for CC's.
why: Law 9's 2026-08-15 clause: 'anything settled by measurement trumps approvals by even me' — a berth under a PROVED ticket has nothing left for his approval to add. Telos: the system must not cost the one funding it has; Akien 2026-09-15: 'we're getting buried in things akien has to look at again, and i can't keep up.' Law 7: derived, never written, so a record of truth (his reviewed log) never collapses a measurement into an approval.
how: In cairn/machines/skill_block (pending_reviews) and cairn/tools/operator_inbox: read the live tickets once, map every berth id named by a ticket's from_idea / intent_berth / sorted_berth to that ticket's cursor, and filter out at read time every berth whose ticket rests at a terminal (PROVED, SUPERSEDED, RETIRED, DROPPED, KILLED, ABSORBED). A berth no ticket names stays pending (an idea or intent nobody cast is his to look at). Troubles render under the CC-owned lane the way open questions already do, unless a trouble carries an open question. Nothing is written: the reviewed log stays his voice only. Measured today: 57 pending, of which the eight from the two 2026-09-14 voyages sit under PROVED tickets.
falsifier: DONE when, measured by cairn/machines/skill_block/proofs/ and cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/: (1) in a scratch world, a berth named by a ticket at [PROVED] is absent from pending_reviews and one named by a ticket at [BUILDME] is present; (2) a berth no ticket names is present; (3) the reviewed log's bytes are identical before and after; (4) the operator banner renders troubles under a CC-owned lane and the operator lane's count excludes them; (5) live: the banner's ARTIFACTS AWAITING REVIEW count after the build equals the count of pending berths whose ticket is non-terminal or unnamed (today the eight under bc7b64626405, c5b6b128a376 and 9adc6fddf185 drain; the rest is a census the build takes). WRONG INTENT: Akien reports a decision he needed to see drained — one instance reds the ticket.

watchme.trigger: every session-open banner render (bin/cmd/slate fires the inbox) — the inbox pokes the probe after it computes the lane, so it costs nothing between renders and no poller exists
watchme.enough: twenty consecutive renders in which every pending berth is either unnamed by any ticket or named by a non-terminal one, and zero WRONG-INTENT questions opened on this ticket — then the probe reports enough and stops counting
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier: the count of pending berths whose ticket was terminal at render (must be 0) and the count of drained berths later re-raised by Akien (must be 0)
watchme.nexus: the operator_inbox component's state (state.json beside the code) and the skill_block tree
watchme.consumer: CC at the next session open; Akien's inbox only if a lack appears

gates_bound: proof gate — teeth under cairn/machines/skill_block/proofs/ and cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/ that a hollow build could not pass: reverting the predicate makes a PROVED ticket's berth reappear in pending; sealed under the tester in netns; hollow at HEAD reads no hollow file.

BUILDME entry gate — rides this cast's intent berth and sorted berth and a berthed chart chain claiming the ticket; the_ticket_has_every_answer_it_needs holds while a bound question is open (none opened at cast).
PROVED exit gate — the verdict artifact answers the validate berth's criteria by instrument; the WATCHME probe the_lane_holds_only_his_decisions armed before the crossing.
artifact door — the ticket file and any charter delta to operator_inbox/intention+why.json write through the door (verbs cast / charter) and the charter write pokes recompile_gate.sh in the same act.
feeds back to origin on failure — a red here re-enters at this cast; a WRONG-INTENT report from Akien is a question opened on this ticket.
